_doc: Cửu Cao Phái (second file, beside cuu_cao.beasts.json): named spirit beasts (linh thú). Proposal, unpriced (review/RANKED.md A7, 2026-11-25; form of sects/cuu_cao.beasts.json). An owned beast is a people record with is_beast and owner_id, and its owner lists it in `beasts` (src/gameplay/character/beast_keeper.gd, assets/data/creatures_linh_thu.json). Capacity is 1 + floor(effective thần hồn / 40). In a fight it is a companion: it adds power_share (0.5) of its chiến lực to its owner's offense, strikes every basic_cooldown, cannot be targeted and never leaves the fight (Combat rule 19). `combat` and `bond` are depth fields; `bond.rider` marks a mount, `bond.keeper` a beast that is not ridden. The owners' cast records do not list these beasts yet.

beasts.species: grey crane of the winter terrace
beasts.appearance: A grey crane with frost-white wingtips that stands on one leg in any gale.

combat.note: The crane A Crane for the Rider (crane-bond-rite) reads through the `crane` tag; his build's Wind Edge strike.

bond.rule: Bonded by shared breath; it takes no other rider after its rider dies (cuu_cao.md section 4).

beasts.backstory: The winter terrace's lead crane. Cừ Vân Lý breathed with it on his first winter flight in 1160 and has flown it every winter since; it has never flown the vein circuit (A096), and he means it never to.

beasts.species: crane chick of the nine marshes
beasts.appearance: A lame, half-fledged crane chick, all knees and down, usually under her arm.

combat.note: Her Beast Den companion; weak, and it will stay weak until it can fly.

bond.rule: Kept, not bonded: she has no Wind to breathe with it, so it is hers by feeding only.

beasts.backstory: Hatched lame in the breeding reeds in 1199. The crane doctor wanted to cull it; Mai Lô Tuyết, who has never been off the ground, carried it home instead.
